topic: Why missed calls cost service businesses more than they think

video.title: The Hidden Cost of Every Missed Call
video.description: A practical explanation of how missed calls turn into lost jobs — and how an automated response workflow closes the gap.

scenes.narration: A missed call is often a customer choosing the next business on Google.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic close-up of a phone ringing unanswered in a busy New Zealand trade workshop, realistic natural light, immediate tension, precise camera push-in, synchronized workshop ambience

scenes.narration: The loss is invisible because the job never reaches your calendar or quote system.
scenes.visual_prompt: LTX-2.3 cinematic B-roll, empty appointment calendar and unanswered call notifications, modern service business office, controlled slow lateral camera motion, realistic, no text

scenes.narration: Across a week, a few missed opportunities can become thousands in unrealised revenue.
scenes.visual_prompt: LTX-2.3 visual metaphor of individual incoming leads fading away across a working week, premium documentary style, restrained motion graphics integrated into a real office environment, no readable text

scenes.narration: A fast automated response can qualify the lead and recover the conversation in seconds.
scenes.visual_prompt: Premium product-demo style sequence showing an incoming call becoming an immediate helpful text response and a confirmed booking, believable mobile interface without logos or readable private data, synchronized notification sounds

scenes.narration: The owner receives the context, not another task, and takes over only when needed.
scenes.visual_prompt: LTX-2.3 cinematic business owner receiving a concise lead summary while working, calm confident reaction, authentic New Zealand small business setting, clean composition, no text

scenes.narration: Measure the calls you miss, then build the smallest workflow that recovers them.
scenes.visual_prompt: Confident cinematic closing image of a service business phone dashboard turning from missed opportunities to confirmed jobs, premium restrained lighting, clean negative space for a call to action, synchronized positive resolution sound
